settings.title: We Don't Just Paint. We Protect What You've Built.

settings.editor: Platinum Painting is a Gold Coast team painting homes, businesses and strata buildings. Every job starts with what the surface needs to last, then how it should look.
Cleaning, repairs, sanding and priming before any topcoat goes on. Good prep is what makes a coating last.
Products and systems chosen for Gold Coast UV, salt air and summer rain, so your finish keeps protecting for years.

Sun, salt and rain wear an exterior down year after year. A full repaint with the right preparation and coating system restores the colour and seals the surface again. Drag the handle to see the difference.

settings.title: Painting Services That Protect and Impress

settings.editor: Washable, low-odour finishes that resist scuffs, moisture and everyday wear.
Coatings rated for UV, salt air and summer storms.
Durable, specified finishes scheduled around your trading hours.
Planned repaint programs that protect shared buildings.
Cleaning, repairs and membrane coatings that seal out water.
Flexible systems that bridge hairline cracks and stay weathertight.
We also restore timber decks and pergolas and offer colour consultations.
Painting is about more than looks. It is a protective coating that helps surfaces last longer in all weather conditions.
Strong Queensland UV breaks down unprotected surfaces, causing chalking, fading and cracking. We use UV-stable coatings that hold their colour.
Coastal salt speeds up corrosion on metal and wears down finishes. The right primers and topcoats slow it right down.
Heavy summer rain finds every gap. Sealed timber, render and roofing keep water out and stop rot and mould before they start.
